#include <string>
#include <cctype>

int main() {
    int how;
    std::cin >> how;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after integer
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    bool inside = false;
    std::string current;
    int max = 0;
    int words = 0;

    for (char c : s) {
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                inside = true;
                if (current.length() > max) max = current.length();
                current.clear();
                break;
            case ')':
                inside = false;
                if (!current.empty()) {
                    words++;
                    current.clear();
                }
                break;
            case '_':
                if (inside) {
                    if (!current.empty()) {
                        words++;
                        current.clear();
                    }
                } else {
                    if (current.length() > max) max = current.length();
                    current.clear();
                }
                break;
            default:
                if (std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) {
                    current.push_back(c);
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    if (current.length() > max) max = current.length();

    std::cout << max << " " << words << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
